purpose: Fixed five-seed supplemental pair-disjoint evaluation. Same Stage1 settings, no tuning. All models fitted and checkpoint hashes frozen before any new test predictions.

split.group: unordered pair of src_ip and dst_ip; ports excluded; both directions together

structural_audit_known_after_fixing_spli.note: These are data-support diagnostics, not prediction/accuracy metrics. Report class shift and missing attack types.

gam.type: additive cubic B-spline logistic GAM, no interactions

new_unknown_category_policy.categorical_onehot: Known categories 1..card-1 only; unseen->all-zero block. Do not add untrained random MLP weights for category0.
new_unknown_category_policy.kan: After fit, set never-trained table slot0 to0 and verify identical train logits. Document prior values. No edits to historical headers/checkpoints.

metrics.comparison_note: Seeds are optimizer repetitions, not independent captures; score differences from old split are not causal leakage estimates.
metrics.stage2_partition: Same fixed held-out test for every model and seed
metrics.test_metrics_computed_note: Describes planned Stage2 execution; not evidence it has already run.

next_gate: Inspect complete Windows run and recorded warning status; retain all outcomes before code/paper integration. No automated hardware access.
write_scope: New runs/PAIR_STAGE2_<UTC>_<id> only; no existing project edits, no serial or hardware access.
known_results_at_freeze: Stage1 validation results were observed; original canonical-test metrics already public. No Stage2 pair-test model scores have been computed or inspected by this workflow before this protocol freeze.

stage2.training_scope: 119334 training rows only; validation is not merged into training
stage2.shared_preprocessor: Same training rows, selection target, fixed preprocessing seed and settings for all models and model seeds. Verify metadata equality.
stage2.no_selection: No best seed, model, threshold or hyperparameter selected from validation or test. Report all outcomes including warnings and failures.
stage2.summary: Per-model mean, sample standard deviation, min and max of metrics over the fixed five seeds. Descriptive optimization variation only; no confidence interval, significance test, or pooling repeated predictions as independent rows.
stage2.paired_comparisons: Per-seed KAN minus DT5, MLP16 and GAM for BA, FPR and F1; mean/sample-SD/min/max, descriptive only.
stage2.subgroups: Full test; actual transformed model inputs matching training vs not matching; attack type TPR and normal FPR with class counts. Single-class BA and AUROC undefined, report null.
stage2.hardware_checkpoint_selection: None; no firmware exported or old measured checkpoint changed.
stage2.limitation: One hash-based split of one dataset; seeds are not independent captures, devices or splits. Host and model-input overlap remain. Test lacks backdoor, ransomware and xss.
